title: RoTA-Bench: Evaluating 3D Spatial Reasoning through Interactive Projection Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.17665v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can vision-language models turn 2D observations into 3D understanding that supports precise action? This requires inferring object geometry, anticipating the effects of rotation, and refining actions through visual feedback. We introduce RoTA-Bench to evaluate these abilities through interactive 3D-to-2D projection alignment. Given a target silhouette, a model observes a rotated object and chooses successive rotations to recover the target projection within a limited action budget. Our automated pipeline constructs silhouette-preserving 3D objects from 2D icons and uses reversible initialization to guarantee solvability, yielding 674 tasks and a stratified 100-task test set. translated_title: RoTA-Bench：通过交互式投影对齐评估三维空间推理
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型能否将二维观测转化为支持精确动作的三维理解？这需要推断物体几何结构、预判旋转的效果，并通过视觉反馈来修正动作。我们提出RoTA-Bench，通过交互式的三维到二维投影对齐来评估这些能力。给定一个目标轮廓，模型观察一个经过旋转的物体，并在有限的动作预算内选择连续的旋转操作，以恢复出目标投影。我们的自动化流水线从二维图标构建保持轮廓的三维物体，并采用可逆初始化来保证任务可解性，共生成674个任务以及一个分层的100任务测试集。实验结果表明：(i) 人类与模型之间仍存在显著差距：GPT-5.6-Sol仅在17%的任务上取得成功，而20名本科生参与者共同完成了四轮测试集，成功率达到100%；(ii) 图像空间与姿态空间中的进展可以……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: RoTA-Bench是一个通过交互式三维到二维投影对齐任务来评估视觉语言模型三维空间推理能力的新基准，其自动化流水线保证了任务的可解性，并揭示了当前最强模型（GPT-5.6-Sol仅17%成功率）与人类（100%成功率）之间的巨大差距。
en_tdlr: RoTA-Bench is a new benchmark that evaluates vision-language models' 3D spatial reasoning through interactive 3D-to-2D projection alignment tasks, using an automated pipeline that guarantees solvability, and reveals a large human-model gap (GPT-5.6-Sol achieves only 17% success while humans achieve 100%).
